positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what is the durable asset in an intelligence practice — the substrate that produces it, or the perspective that interprets it?
positions.why: Both expressions draw the same line: one names the distinction (owned vs rented intelligence) and the other locates it structurally (substrate as commodity, perspective as kept asset). Read together they cohere as one directional claim about where value/ownership actually sits, rather than two unrelated remarks.
